exact_window_disjointness: No window (as an exact token array) appears in more than one of the training, held-out and control sets.
exact_window_disjointness_note: This compares exact 256-token arrays. It is not a statement about whether two windows were cut from the same source document.
text_field: Decoded from token_ids with the tokenizer above, for reading. It is not normalized or repaired; a window can begin or end inside a word or a multi-byte character, which decodes to a replacement character. token_ids are the executed sample.
